description: Update fields on an existing customer. Fields you omit are left untouched. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. There is no notes field here. To leave a note about the work, put it on the job with hcp_add_job_note (it rides the job record and reads back on it); a customer-level note is a Housecall Pro dashboard field this surface does not write, though it does read back inline on hcp_get_customer.
name: hcp_update_customer
